title: Forced Migration
field: Forced migration research (humanities and social sciences)
about: The Gerda Henkel Foundation's Forced Migration special programme accepts applications for individual postdoctoral research scholarships. Applicants must hold a doctorate no more than eight years old; digital applications in English must reach the Foundation by 29 April 2027.
requirements: Only individual research scholarships for postdoctoral researchers are funded in the 2027 call
Doctorate no more than eight years old at the time of application
